maddeler.e:
اقترعوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَعُوا (iqtaraʕū) /iq.ta.ra.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# اُقْتُرِعُوا (uqturiʕū) /uq.tu.ri.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# اِقْتَرِعُوا (iqtariʕū) /iq.ta.ri.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
